_comment: Open option positions held in Robinhood (co-pilot flow). The daily run
reads this file and applies mve.position_manager's exit rules to each
entry, printing a POSITION REVIEW in docs/reports/paper_trading.txt.
Add a line when you execute a trade; delete it when you close.
Editable directly on github.com — no Mac needed.
Fields: ticker, contract (label only), quantity, entry_price (premium
per contract), expiry YYYY-MM-DD, invalidation_price and
entry_underlying (from the pick that generated the trade), entry_date.
Omitting entry_underlying or entry_date is allowed — the rules that
need them report NOT CHECKED rather than silently passing.
